title: runstate's gitRun carries no maintenance pins, so its fixture git can start the detached maintenance tick qsn chased out of reconcile
body: gitRun (internal/runstate/origin_test.go) builds its environment from os.Environ() with no gitbin.WithNoAutoMaintenance and no WithNoAutoMaintenance, so every commit, push and fetch it runs ends by potentially starting `git maintenance run --auto --detach` in t.TempDir repositories. On this host the read-only grade's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT pins mask it; on CI's unpinned git 2.55 (geometric, repacking from two loose objects) that is exactly the shape that made reconcile's t.TempDir RemoveAll fail with 'directory not empty' and cost two days (tick qsn) — reconcile fixed it by pinning the harness runner and added a trace2 guard, runstate's gitRun was left unpinned. A one-in-forty flake in the full suite on CI, outside this tick's host-side scope.
